caption: The drawing displays four views of two different brass or gold-colored door knockers, symmetrically arranged on a plain, light beige background. The top left quadrant contains a front view of a teardrop-shaped knocker attached to a round, tiered, slightly domed backplate. The top right quadrant shows a side view of the same knocker and backplate. The bottom left quadrant presents another side view of the same type of knocker. The bottom right quadrant features a front view of a similar teardrop-shaped knocker, but this one is mounted on an ornate backplate with a symmetrical, stylized floral or shell motif. The metallic knockers exhibit shading to indicate three-dimensionality. In the lower left corner, there is a horizontal scale in inches, and the lower right corner contains the text "JANET BIZA" in uppercase letters. The objects are evenly spaced with considerable empty space surrounding them.
title: Drawer Pull
